scope: Passive QEMU Ethernet PCAP in an isolated synthetic station; relative timestamps only. No live firmware writes or retries by the probe client.
conclusion: Three delayed POST flows spend most of their time awaiting SYN retransmission; HTTP response headers follow request arrival within 50 ms. This does not identify which QEMU DMA, network or SDK layer lost the first SYN.
limitations: A diagnostic observation, not a full H09 concurrency/performance or physical result. Original PCAP and uncommitted probe/parser are retained in the local ignored diagnostic directory; raw addresses, ports and absolute timestamps are not published.
